thread:
Evan: kicking off ACME POC — need to align on goals, sandbox access, and a timeline. high-level asks from ACME: real-time summarization of support tickets, latency <300ms 95th, and privacy for PII.
Maria: noted. can you confirm what sample data they'll provide? CSV export or S3 access?
Evan: customer prefers S3. they can give a read-only bucket with redacted files. asks if we can host a sandbox in us-east-1.
Liam: pricing/ops note: for a 4-week pilot at ~5 rps steady, recommend Hosted with dedicated burst or Reserved small pool. will price T-shirt small/medium for committed Dedicated if they want SLA. I'll draft numbers.
Shreya: security checklist — need DPA signed, SOC2 report, and KMS usage for bucket (customer-managed ok?). also request minimal list of IAM roles we need.
Evan: ACME ok with dev-managed KMS for pilot but wants KMS key rotation policy. they will sign DPA.
Maria: for evals, let's define pass/fail: 1) extractive summary "ROUGE-like" score >= 0.6 vs golden set; 2) PII leakage rate <0.01% on sample prompts; 3) latency 95th <300ms for 512-token context in us-east-1. timeline: week1 infra + sample ingest; week2 prompt tuning + redaction checks; week3 model tuning + evals; week4 customer validation.
Liam: quick ask on data redaction — do we need them to pre-redact or can we run our redaction pipeline?
Maria: we can run redaction, but prefer customer pre-redact one representative shard. If they can't, we will run automated redaction during ingest and provide the regex + sample code for review.
Maria: example redaction snippet:
```
# simple PII redaction (python)
import re
text = re.sub(r"\b(\d{3}-\d{2}-\d{4})\b", "[SSN]", text)
text = re.sub(r"\b([A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,})\b", "[EMAIL]", text)
```
Shreya: infra question: does sandbox require VPC peering or can they use signed S3 URLs? VPC peering will need approval from their network team.
infra-bot: deploy set up: sandbox-vpc request created (#SR-1123). status: provisioning.
Evan: action items: (1) Liam to send pilot pricing estimate by EOD; (2) ACME to share 1GB sample shard + prefix policy; (3) Shreya to send security questionnaire + KMS docs; (4) Maria to prep redaction script and eval prompts. target start: next Monday. @here :thumbsup:
